content.text: Is it safe to assume that all of the "member" resources in the plantpatents.ttl exist in the repository?
This report is a little dated, but I saw it today and, FWIW, I can't reproduce in 4.6.0, 4.6.1, or 4.7.0.  I tested, too, with many references to internal resources, all of which definitely existed.
: would you mind retesting on your side to verify that it is no longer an issue?
This problem no longer affects the current version of Fedora.
While PUTting the attached TTL file, fedora threw a 500 with the following stack trace in the logs.
SEVERE: An I/O error has occurred while writing a response message entity to the container output stream.
Caused by: java.io.IOException: Response header too large

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are closed can be reopened.
